record.rationale: React DOM platform code binds existing canonical source model/view and shared Sfx contracts;it does not claim to translate a native VCL implementation file.
responsibilities: Task0V5WR6 connects the production Calc route to actual ScDocument,ScViewData and ScDocShell owners through shared SfxObjectShell,SfxUndoManager,SfxInterface,SfxViewFrame,dispatcher and command bindings. Controlled React presenters reuse Writer toolbar styles,Tailwind,Lucide and global fonts. The supported slice includes plain scalar/native local-A1 input,recalculation,cancel,selection,name-box navigation,sheet append/switch,typed token-valued undo/redo and bounded browser viewport projection. Compiled formula adoption retains code errors in history;sheet deletion ends formula subscriptions and renumbers source cells. One real model owns cells;browser state contains transient input/geometry only. This is a bounded editable workspace,not full Calc/native parity.

Task2BTWEE connects Calc native OpenFromCalc26204,SaveAs5502 and ExportTo5829 Sfx slots to actual ODS workflows and the shared Writer-style file dialog. Current input commits before file focus;primary autosave flushes before open/copy/import;computer imports use existing ODS candidate loading and collision-resolved browser identity;named copies and browser opens use actual primary IO. Shell Export uses a separate medium and leaves primary identity,modified state,generation and undo-save position unchanged. Shared CommandMenuBar and CommandButton render consumed native File/Edit placements and normalized source labels/shortcuts. Open dialogs make background Calc chrome/grid inert and restore actual grid focus on close. Native slot/placement/resource identities are preserved for consumed commands;this is not complete native menu/UI parity.

TaskFKYDT8 ports ScTabView SelectNextTab and SetTabNo sheet grouping from tabview3.cxx and SelectAllTables/DeselectAllTables from tabview2.cxx over real ScViewData/ScMarkData. Native WrapNextPrevSheetTab defaults true. Existing per-sheet cursor state survives navigation;normal selection retains a partial group on already-selected target sheets and collapses an all-selected group. Native Sfx slots26543,26544,26561,26562,26361,26365 use original operation/state boundaries. Navigation commits the real input draft first and rejected drafts prevent movement. Source group-only commands do not change model generation,dirty state or history. Shared CommandMenuBar executes real slots and browser Ctrl/Meta+PageUp/PageDown plus tab-arrow navigation use the same dispatcher. Hidden/alternate sheets,reference editing,drawing/window services and full native parity remain unported.

Task1J8SQQ connects native JumpToTable/SID_CURRENTTAB26042 and one-based UInt16 Nr to actual Calc sheet view ownership. The asynchronous menu path uses the existing shared SfxDialogController,actual document sheet names and native selected-name result semantics. ScGoToTabDlg retains native ordered single selection,initial active sheet,case-sensitive untrimmed substring mask,selection clearing after filter rebuild,double-click acceptance,empty acceptance with no movement and cancellation. Shared Writer DialogHeader and office-dialog styles render the original entry/list/OK/Cancel/Help composition;Help stays disabled because its service is unported. Pending input must commit before opening;modal background is inert and file/page accelerators are suppressed;session closure cancels the request before destroying the model. This is not hidden-sheet/reference/VCL service parity or full Calc UI completion.

TaskYDAWMM repairs actual browser accessibility defects exposed by task10 axe acceptance. Shared top-level CommandMenuBar controls retain their native HTML buttons,existing focus/keyboard/dispatch state machine and visual styling while exposing the required menuitem role. The shared Writer/Calc document title gains h1 semantics with identical text sizing and line height. Calc row/column/corner headers now contain their native selection buttons within proper header elements;corner accessible text and a valid status container complete the grid/chrome semantics. Tests migrate queries to the real menu items and native header buttons,not compatibility aliases or audit exclusions. Native command/cell/selection/input ownership is unchanged. Actual foundation/launcher axe checks and all three Writer dialog geometry viewports pass;full native UI/accessibility service parity remains unclaimed.

TaskQXFX41 ports original ScInputMode NONE0 TYPE1 TABLE2 TOP3 and bounded ScInputHandler mode predicates/toggle at native source boundaries. Browser scalar input shares one draft:TYPE arrows commit/move,TABLE and TOP keep caret navigation. Original SID_SETINPUTMODE26552 and F2 use the same shared-menu dispatcher;TYPE/TABLE toggles preserve draft/history,TOP commits before TABLE and rejected input retains mode/error. GetMode is a read-only browser projection of eMode,not an upstream method. EditEngine,protection,formula reference selection,autocomplete and VCL synchronization remain unported;no full native input parity is claimed.

TaskC5HB8X generates complete pinned sheettab.xml14commands/3separators and native PopupLabel/dialog-suffix projections through shared Writer parser/catalog tooling;451Calc commands remain source-hashed with11top menus and17explicit save-policy dispositions. Actual framework CommandPopupMenu is reused for pointer,ContextMenu and ShiftF10 with shared focus,disabled selection,outside dismissal and geometry. Source ScTabControl SwitchToPageId already-selected return preserves canonical active sheet/group;unselected requests commit supported input and select one target;blank-strip requests retain selection. Native ScInputHandler bFormulaMode/mbEditingExistingContent and StartsLikeFormula predicate distinguish new plus/minus/equals input from existing content. Explicit browser UpdateInputState/ResetInputState projections supply the actual draft/lifecycle without pretending to implement EditEngine or full UpdateFormulaMode. Formula/modal requests are rejected. Existing native SelectAll/Deselect slots execute;unported Insert/Remove/Rename/format/event services remain disabled. Full VCL TabBar current-page state,protection/reference highlighting,EditEngine and whole Calc parity remain unported.

Renders the current Calc editing slice using shared Writer office header,menus,complete visible source standard toolbar with common icons,popup and file dialogs. Native Sfx state owns availability; no fake unsupported command handlers. Full formatting toolbar and whole Calc UI remain unported.

Task98VCB0 mounts the complete pinned native formatobjectbar cell-context resource using actual shared Writer selectors,format glyphs,icons and styles. Source-visible unported formatting commands are disabled through real Sfx state;unknown font name/height remain blank. No fake formatting slots,document attributes or defaults are introduced.

TaskZXWXQ8 connects original no-argument SelectRow/SelectColumn slots26548/26547 to normal-grid ScTabView MarkRows/MarkColumns over actual ScViewData/ScMarkData. Existing simple selection endpoints expand to full axis extents;unmarked selection uses current normal cursor. Cursor and selected sheets remain;selection alone changes neither cells,dirty state nor history. Existing browser input owner commits or rejects pending drafts before selection and publishes real changes. Original ShiftSpace selects rows;column selection uses CtrlSpace on nonMac and AltSpace on Mac,only from the actual grid,not nested editors,composition or modal input. Actual shared Writer menus/resources/dispatch remain reused. Native reference-mode,end-block/window callbacks,parameterized Col/Row/Modifier automation and full native UI/core parity remain unverified.

TaskZXWXQ8 also projects the original InitBlockMode start to the existing browser anchor independently of the active cell,so subsequent shift extension uses the selected axis origin. No additional model or native window service is fabricated.

TaskGKVVR7 connects source standard automatic row-height arithmetic and genuine compressed geometry/flags to current FontHeight UI and attribute Undo/Redo. Original contiguous pool defaults extend through ATTR_MARGIN143. Standard uniform-script unwrapped/unrotated rows use native 256-twip startup minimum,23-twip correction,margin/emphasis and pixel-change conditions. Selected sheets retain one original shared context. React uses actual row segments and bounded physical scrolling; ODS row styles apply to real sheet storage. Device-based initialization/script scanning,rich/wrapped/rotated/merged layout,drawing/hidden rows and standalone height dialogs remain unported. Nonstandard represented attribute profiles decline adjustment;unrepresented foreign layout properties,mixed-script text and device layout remain unverified. Writer primary saving/no-recovery/visible-content policy is retained; broad parity remains unverified.
